effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:enderference: Makes the target unable to teleport or be teleported.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:enthralled: Enthralled mobs won't attack the caster but defend them.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:frozen: The target is frozen and can't heal, next fire damage taken is increased but dispels the effect.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:hellfire: The magic flames burns even nether creatures making them vulnerable to fire. It slighly decrease damage taken from earth, but let magic damage pierce through some of the armor.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:hymn_of_order: Unobtainable potion, for Admin use. Sets the punished player's mana to 1 and disables spellcasting, greatly reducing their chances to create chaos in the server.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:life_link: Caster will split incoming damage with the target and the target will split incoming healing with the caster. Using Cut will dispel the effect on both sides.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:mana_shield: Use mana to mitigate damage taken and add a chance to not suffer from negative effects.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:mist: Similar to blindness, mist reduces the field of vision of mobs and players
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:repel: The target is repelled from one or more places by a magic force.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:rust: Makes the entity armor rust temporarily, dropping its armor points.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:slip_feet: Makes the entity slide as if on ice while on normal blocks, increased slipperiness on ice blocks.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:static_charged: Calls a lightning to hit the afflicted when the duration ends.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:venom: The target is poisoned with a deadly venom and takes more damage from poison spores.
effect_descriptions.ars_elemental:watery_grave: Makes the target sink and run out of air quicker.
effect_descriptions.sauce:contingency: When a specific event triggers, it will cast the spell on the entity.
effect_descriptions.sauce:rage: Causes the target to attack nearby entities, even allies, and deal more melee damage.
effect_descriptions.sauce:spell_crit_up: Increases critical strike chance of spells.
